stem: A minor injury required first aid, but the underlying hazard is still present. When is the event follow-through complete?
choices: As soon as first aid is finished
When the hazard has been evaluated and the required correction, ownership and documentation have been addressed
When the injured worker returns to the task
When the incident is no longer discussed
rationale: Treating the injury does not correct the underlying hazard. Effective follow-through addresses the condition that created the event and documents responsibility/status.
